ticket.summary: Proactive replacement of 14-year-old 40-gal gas water heater; free on-site estimate booked Wed 9/2 8-10am, customer wants firm written quote before anything is ordered.
mitigation_advice: No active leak or emergency; unit is functioning, replacement is preventative
Watch for rust-colored water, puddling at the tank base, or rumbling noises and call sooner if any appear

quote_lines.description: BALLPARK ONLY (verbal range $1,750-$2,300): standard 40-gal atmospheric-vent gas water heater supplied and installed, incl. water/gas flex connectors, shutoff, drip pan, haul-away of old unit, 3-4 hrs labor
BALLPARK ONLY: municipal permit + inspection, billed at cost ($150-$250); quoted to customer as separate from install price

ticket.customer_message: Absolutely - nothing gets ordered or installed without your sign-off. The tech will do the walkthrough, confirm the model and any code items, and hand you a firm written quote on the spot. You decide from there. You're booked: Wednesday, September 2, 8-10am. I'll send a reminder Tuesday, and the tech will text when they're on the way. If you spot rust-colored water, puddling at the base, or hear rumbling before then, give us a shout - that's a 'sooner rather than later' sign. See you Wednesday, Hal!
